name: OROCHI — unique shape-first chassis
notes:
Official orochi_or2i, bespoke primary hull and weapon-bearing geometry (giant_overhead_pods); unique head (embedded), jointed two-stage arms, multi-stage legs, physically recessed counted muzzles. Miniature silhouette likeness still draft pending angle-by-angle refinement.
